title: The Great British Bake Off Dataset & AI Training Corpus
description: A comprehensive tidy dataset and AI training corpus for the television series The Great British Bake Off (broadcast as The Great British Baking Show in North America). Contains structured, relational datasets in tidy format across 17 UK series (in CSV, Apache Parquet, SQLite, Apache Arrow, GeoJSON, and R formats), alongside multi-turn conversational instruction-tuning and RAG JSONL corpora.
